definitions.content: The closeness of agreement between results of successive measurements of the same measurand carried out under the same conditions and within a relatively short period of time.

notes.content: The same conditions include the following: the method of measurement, the operator, the measuring instrument, the location, and the environmental conditions.

definitions.content: Concordance entre les résultats de mesurages consécutifs du même mesurande, effectués dans les mêmes conditions et sur une relativement brève période de temps.
